description: This file defines the EmployeeJobController class in the OrangeHRM system. It manages the pre-rendering setup for employee job details, including fetching related data such as job titles, categories, company structure, employment statuses, locations, and termination reasons, to be used in the associated view component.

classes.name: EmployeeJobController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing data related to employee job details for the view, utilizing various services to fetch necessary data and passing it to the frontend component.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobCategoryService.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmploymentStatusService.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the data needed for rendering the employee job view, including fetching employee-specific data and setting it in a Vue component.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of data group identifiers used for capability or permission checks.
